goal: Implement the smallest supervised production conveyor from Gmail job-alert observations to deterministic operational JOBS/LOG mutation plans, with Google Sheets writes executed through the supervised connector layer rather than embedded provider credentials. Preserve Gmail observations as untrusted discovery provenance; normalize without promoting source claims into Employer Truth; resolve exact-role identity only from exact employer/system identity plus exact requisition/opportunity identifier; keep unresolved identity unresolved; converge duplicate nominations idempotently; and make malformed/ambiguous inputs fail visibly. This milestone does not attach Match Truth, Candidate Truth, Employer Truth mutation, package generation, Vercel, browser automation, scheduling, supplemental Scout sources, or autonomous submission.
acceptance_conditions: Gmail/provider I/O remains outside deterministic truth semantics: raw message content and source metadata enter only as untrusted discovery observations; no source-provided posting age, fit score, work-authorization statement, or other nomination claim is promoted into Employer Truth or Match Truth.

The deterministic core accepts a bounded raw-message observation shape and emits validated DiscoveryLead records with source provenance, source message identity, observed_at, discovery URL(s), employer/role text when present, exact requisition/opportunity identifier when present, and explicit unresolved fields when absent; it never invents missing identifiers.

Exact-role identity is separate from src/job_id.py and requires exact employer/system identity plus exact requisition/opportunity identifier. The canonical operational Job_ID/exact-role key is derived only from that exact identity tuple; generate_job_id(company, role), company/title hashes, fuzzy title normalization, URL-only identity, or any other surrogate may not create or select the canonical JOBS entity. If exact employer/system identity or exact requisition/opportunity identifier is unresolved, canonical Job_ID remains unset and the lead stays VERIFICATION_REQUIRED; no fuzzy merge or fallback entity key is permitted.
Multiple discovery observations for the same exact role converge on one operational JOBS entity while preserving each source observation/provenance record needed for audit and reprocessing.

The same Gmail message processed twice is idempotent: it cannot create a second source observation, second canonical operational job, or duplicate successful LOG event for the same processing identity.
The same exact requisition nominated by multiple Gmail alert sources converges on one operational job while retaining distinct source observations.

Malformed email content, unsupported message structure, ambiguous employer identity, or ambiguous/missing exact requisition identity fails visibly into deterministic PROCESSING_ERROR or VERIFICATION_REQUIRED output; no record silently disappears and no guessed identity is created.

Operational JOBS mutation plans use only the Slice 1 JOBS fields required by docs/SUPERVISED_PRODUCTION_V1.md and preserve future truth fields as unset/unknown rather than manufacturing Freshness, Geography, OPT, Candidate Condition, Threshold, Match, Decision, Bora Decision, Package, or Application results.

Operational LOG mutation plans include Run_ID, Timestamp, Stage, Source, Job_ID when resolved, Status, Error_Code when applicable, Engine_Baseline, and Notes/provenance sufficient to reconstruct what happened.

Google Sheets writes are provider-adapter effects applied from validated deterministic mutation plans through the supervised connector layer; repository code does not contain Google OAuth secrets, Gmail credentials, Sheets credentials, account identifiers, or hard-coded spreadsheet IDs.

The canonical Sheet initialization plan contains exactly the seven doctrine tabs SETTINGS, JOBS, EVIDENCE, CLAIMS, APPLICATIONS, NETWORK, LOG; Slice 1 writes only JOBS and LOG and does not repurpose the other tabs.
Re-running the same mailbox window against the same existing JOBS/LOG state produces no duplicate logical job rows and no duplicate successful processing records.

A controlled batch fixture covers duplicate delivery, same requisition from two sources, missing requisition identifier, malformed email, exact employer/requisition collision prevention, and rerun/idempotency.

At least one supervised real Gmail batch may be exercised after implementation using the connected Gmail/Sheets tools, but production source data, message bodies, email addresses, spreadsheet IDs, and credentials are not committed into the repository.
Existing submitted-opportunity dedupe and application-history exact employer + requisition rules remain unchanged and green.
No existing truth-engine, Candidate Truth, Employer Truth, Match Truth, resume/package, application decision, OPT semantic, or role-selection behavior changes.
All focused tests, canonical full Assurance, and Golden pass on the exact implementation candidate bytes.
An independent adversarial reviewer evaluates the exact immutable implementation diff and returns SAFE (or all findings are causally adjudicated and repaired before refreeze).
stop_conditions: Implementation requires Gmail or Google credentials/secrets to be embedded in the repository or environment configuration committed by this milestone.
Implementation requires a hard-coded Google Sheet ID, Gmail account identity, label ID, or user-specific provider identifier in repository code.
Implementation requires modifying src/job_id.py or using company+role fuzzy identity as exact-role identity.
Implementation uses generate_job_id(company, role), a company/title hash, fuzzy title normalization, discovery URL alone, or any surrogate key to create/select the canonical operational JOBS entity.

Implementation requires changing any existing Job decision enum, Match Truth semantic, Employer Truth semantic, Candidate Truth semantic, OPT semantic, package/resume behavior, application lifecycle semantics, or protected schema.

Implementation requires Match Truth, Employer Truth verification, package generation, Vercel deployment, cron/scheduling, browser automation, Handshake/Simplify direct adapters, Firecrawl, Claude Scout, or any source beyond Gmail.
Implementation requires writing EVIDENCE, CLAIMS, APPLICATIONS, NETWORK, or SETTINGS operational data beyond creating the canonical empty tab/header structure allowed by this slice.
Implementation cannot represent unresolved exact-role identity without guessing, fuzzy merge, or silent drop.
Implementation cannot guarantee idempotency for repeated Gmail messages and repeated mailbox-window runs using deterministic source/message and exact-role keys.
Any historical application-history or submitted-opportunity exact-identity invariant must be weakened.
Any path outside allowed_paths must change.
Independent reviewer finds a consequential defect that cannot be repaired within this bounded provider-neutral ingestion/persistence seam.
review_requirements: MANDATORY_INDEPENDENT_EXACT_BYTE_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_BEFORE_COMMIT_PUSH; reviewer identity is replaceable, but reviewer independence and exact immutable candidate bytes are mandatory. Deterministic focused tests plus full canonical Assurance and Golden are required after every mutation that changes the frozen fingerprint.
human_approval_requirements: BORA_EXPLICIT_AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED_BEFORE_ANY_SLICE_1_IMPLEMENTATION_MUTATION. Contract authoring/review alone does not authorize implementation. After implementation reaches green exact-byte review, Bora retains final release/merge authority. SUBMIT/PURSUE external human gates remain outside this milestone.
